Theme changes

What changed for theme authors in each release, newest first. Each release starts with what you may need to do; the rest needs nothing from you.

3.0.0: check your theme

Installed themes keep loading. A layout file that breaks a stricter rule falls back to Neutral's on its own, and Dev Mode's check names it; a package that breaks an import rule below is refused at import and export until it is fixed. If a row matches your theme, do what the right column says.

If your theme…Do this
has preview images outside previews/Move them into previews/ and update theme.json. Import and export refuse any other path.
has a settings field or option with an empty label, or a number default outside min..maxGive every label 1 to 40 characters and keep defaults in range. Otherwise that field is left out of the settings form.
ships layout/popups/modActions.json or layout/popups/settingsNav.jsonDelete them. Nothing ever loaded them, and import now refuses them.
uses a text node role outside the list of tenUse display, heading, subheading, body, label, caption, micro, button, chip or data (LAY-03).
has an SVG that links outside itselfKeep href to #id or embedded PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF data. No <foreignObject>, stylesheet links, @import, outside url(…) or CSS escapes.
has a CSS selector with a pseudo-class right after a space, such as [data-el="x"] :hoverAnchor it: [data-el="x"] [data-part="y"]:hover or > :hover. :nth-child() takes An+B, odd or even only. See CSS API.
declares a --z-* custom propertyRemove it. The stacking order belongs to the launcher (CSS-04).
cancels launcher spacing with > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden])Use > :not(:last-child). Launcher spacing now sits below or right of each child but the last.
sets a colour, background or opacity on an element and relied on the built-in hover or disabled lookAdd your own :hover or [data-state~="disabled"] rule. Your rule now wins in every state.
styles the box part in a filter popup as a checkboxStyle it as an icon column: it holds a check icon (the tag popup's ✓/✗ instead). Select picked rows with [data-part="option"][data-state~="selected"]; excluded tags carry excluded instead.
styles the tag popup's ✓/✗ with [data-part="option"] > [data-part="indicator"]Use a descendant selector: the indicator now sits inside the box part.
styles update.install, update.viewRelease or the workshopMod score, subscribers, include or exclude elements as plain textThey now start with an icon part. Give them display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: …, or hide [data-part="icon"].
places server.downloadSizeCheck its new wording ("{n} mods", then "Download size: {size}") and drop any [data-state~="checking"] rule.
places server stats inside a "context": "selection" containerThey draw as in the server info window now, without the built-in "PLAYERS", "PING", "TIME" and "MODS" labels. Add your own text beside each element, and move [data-part="label"] styling to it.
places settings.sectionTitle, sectionDescription or sectionIcon in a plain boxThey are inline now. Add display: block or put them in a column stack if you want separate lines.
sizes the mod.thumbnail placeholder as an iconCheck it: the placeholder is text now.
ships layout/popups/serverActions.json or serverLoad.jsonCheck them: the server menu now opens them instead of the launcher's own list.
styles notice.launchAdd a [data-state~="success"] rule. The bar now also shows short "Done" messages, such as "Address copied", for two seconds.
started from a starter templateNothing breaks. New themes now start as a copy of Neutral or Tactical; the starters are gone.

Newly required elements are not placed for you. A screen that lacks a required element falls back to Neutral's, and Dev Mode names the missing element. When a release lists one, add it to your layout files.

3.0.0: new and fixed

Nothing here needs a change, but you may want to use it.

Layout and settings

  • Setting conditions (hidden: {"setting": …}) now work. A condition on a field the settings check dropped fails LAY-03, and the message names the setting.
  • A settings combination that would hide a required element makes that file fall back, and Dev Mode names the combination.
  • Dev Mode's check lists settings issues beside layout issues, and shows up to 64 combinations.
  • collapsible takes collapseBelow (for example "720px") to fold a region in small windows.
  • A theme can ship layout/popups/modsVerify.json and modsUnsubscribe.json for the mods menus.
  • list.servers, list.mods and list.modFilterResults now honour header and rowGap and emit the scroller and rows parts.

Colours and popups

  • Every window backdrop reads color.scrim. The new optional color.scrimBlocking darkens the Steam required screen.
  • An open popup can't be pushed off screen by a filter or transform on the elements around it; those pause while it is open.
  • Popups work from the keyboard: arrows, Home, End, Enter, Space, and Esc back to the button.
  • Windows open on their main action and close on a click on the backdrop. The backdrop can be styled with [data-modal-host][data-backdrop="dim"].

Elements

  • server.readiness gains basis: "declared", which shows the server's own declared mod state.
  • server.modCount has a vanilla state for a server that is not modded and was never checked.
  • server.region shows the full region name on hover in both formats.
  • Filter popups end with a separator and Clear, like the launcher's own menus.
  • server.menu without a popup file opens Neutral's server actions.
  • Wording now matches the launcher: mod states read Ready, Update or Missing; the list source reads "via index" or "via Steam".

Themes page

  • Every theme id the launcher creates follows the package id rule. A copy named in another script keeps its name and gets an id like local.theme-2. Installed themes keep their ids.
